svg.title: Swara speed against each target
svg.desc: Median of each measurement as a share of its target: Colours after a keystroke, 0.19 ms against under 16 ms; Instant checks after an edit, 1.2 ms against under 50 ms; LilyPond check after the last edit, 100-bar song, 551 ms against under 600 ms; Tidy, 100-bar song, 1.1 ms against under 10 ms; Completion after \, 1.1 ms against under 20 ms; Server ready, 2.3 ms against under 100 ms; PDF after save, 4-bar lesson, 266 ms against about 300 ms; PDF after save, 100-bar song, 1,311 ms against about 1,500 ms; Play, first time, to the first note, about 1,060 ms against about 1,500 ms; Play, later, to the first note, about 4 ms against under 200 ms.
svg.text: Each bar is a measurement's median as a share of its target, so a shorter bar has more room to spare. The figures are the Speed table in this
LilyPond check after the last edit, 100-bar song
Play, first time, to the first note
Play, later, to the first note
Every median sits inside its target.
